'''Baijan'm'hael''' is a word in the [[Old Tongue]] meaning "Attack Leader." It is a title in the [[Asha'man]] military rank that was held by [[Manel Rochaid]] before his death and is considered to be below ''[[Tsorovan'm'hael]]''.
